rca of the issue: Original bug: index.html had lang="en" causing Chrome/Safari auto-translate to replace Italian labels. Fix (already applied by main agent) adds lang="it" + translate="no" + class="notranslate" on <html>, plus meta google=notranslate and Content-Language=it; manifest.json lang=it. Validated via curl + runtime DOM check.
